title: AegisFin Phase 2 Validated Production Fraud Feature Schema
description: Validated, production-compatible feature engineering contract for AegisFin Phase 2 Fraud Detection. Eliminates legacy anonymous IEEE-CIS V-features and unverified signals, establishing an authentic, reproducible schema combining live transaction attributes and Supabase point-in-time entity history.

VALID.description: Fully reproducible identically during both historical training and live inference.

NEEDS_DATA.description: Valuable fraud risk features that currently lack raw input fields, Supabase schema support, or third-party APIs.

INVALID.description: Features rejected due to mathematical instability, alphanumeric casting fragility, or ambiguous multi-entity collinearity.

metadata.anti_leakage_guarantee: Strict point-in-time temporal filtering: historical_timestamp < current_transaction_timestamp enforced on all historical queries.

raw_input_fields.name: transaction_id
raw_input_fields.description: Globally unique payment transaction reference identifier.

raw_input_fields.name: transaction_timestamp
raw_input_fields.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the transaction event.

raw_input_fields.name: customer_id
raw_input_fields.description: Unique identifier of the account holder or customer.

raw_input_fields.name: card_id
raw_input_fields.description: Payment card reference / card1 token identifier.

raw_input_fields.name: device_id
raw_input_fields.description: Client hardware fingerprint or device ID string.

raw_input_fields.name: merchant_id
raw_input_fields.description: Merchant or POS terminal reference identifier.

raw_input_fields.name: product_code
raw_input_fields.description: Transaction category product code (W=Web, H=Home, C=Commercial, S=Specialty, R=Retail).

raw_input_fields.name: address_id
raw_input_fields.description: Billing zip code or location identifier.

raw_input_fields.name: ip_address
raw_input_fields.description: Client IPv4 or IPv6 address initiating transaction.

raw_input_fields.name: country
raw_input_fields.description: Two-letter ISO country code of transaction origin.

Customer Behavioral History.name: customer_tx_count_5m

Customer Behavioral History.live_source: Supabase fraud_transactions query where customer_id=curr and ts in [t_curr - 5m, t_curr)
Customer Behavioral History.formula: float(count(tx in history if tx.customer == curr and t_curr - 300 <= tx.ts < t_curr))

Customer Behavioral History.name: customer_amount_mean

Customer Behavioral History.formula: mean([tx.amount for tx in history if tx.customer == curr and tx.ts < t_curr])

needs_data_features.missing_dependency: Historical IEEE-CIS benchmark dataset did not contain an ISO 2-letter country column; requires establishing an authoritative cross-border country frequency table.
Requires contract and integration with commercial device intelligence vendor (FingerprintJS / Sift); not present in current AegisFin system.
Requires confirmed chargeback/fraud outcome feedback labels in Supabase; current fraud_transactions table does not track dispute labels.
Requires external IP proxy/VPN database integration (MaxMind GeoIP2 Precision or IPQualityScore); not available in offline AegisFin environment.
Requires MaxMind GeoIP2 city/country database to resolve client IP to ISO country for comparison against transaction country.
Requires payment gateway decline webhook ingestion; public.fraud_transactions only records transactions submitted for fraud scoring, not upstream bank declines.
Requires card issuance date from issuing bank API or payment gateway tokenization metadata.
Requires linking customer_id to Supabase auth/profiles.created_at timestamp during fraud feature extraction.
Channel ('WEB', 'MOBILE_APP', 'POS', 'API') is not currently present in Streamlit form or FastAPI FraudPredictionRequest schema.
Shipping destination country is not currently collected in Streamlit or accepted in FastAPI FraudPredictionRequest schema.
Browser client telemetry / User-Agent string is not passed in current JSON payload or extracted from FastAPI request headers.
Requires retaining a rolling 30-day baseline hourly velocity; current Supabase state only tracks all-time aggregates.
Requires 30-day rolling hardware baseline velocity; current Supabase state does not retain device-level rolling windows.

invalid_features.rejection_reason: address_id is an arbitrary alphanumeric identifier in production (e.g., 'ZIP_94103', 'NY'); direct float cast crashes or produces spurious ordinal relationships in tree models.
Ambiguous formulation ('across customer/card') introduces double-counting and collinearity with customer_tx_count_5m and card_tx_count_5m.
Ambiguous entity definition and direct collinear duplicate of customer_tx_count_1h.
